preamble: Fronting of the voiced retroflex fricative [ʐ] to the voiced alveolar fricative [z]. In Polish dialects with mazurzenie (Masovia, Masuria, most of Lesser Poland, eastern and northern Upper Silesia) the retroflex sibilant series merged completely with the dental series, so ż [ʐ] is pronounced [z]; ż from the trill rz is excluded, since rz developed separately.

examples.note: Mazurating dialects merge the postalveolar/retroflex sibilants with the dentals.
Both ż [ʐ] and dż are fronted in the same word.

sources: Gogolewski, S. (2001). Dialectology in Poland, 1873-1997. In Koerner, E. F. K. & Szwedek, A. (eds.), Towards a History of Linguistics in Poland. John Benjamins. https://books.google.com/books?id=CTtT7-JTwioC&pg=PA128
